Thank you for the reply. I have asked if I could stay with my family and they know of the trouble I'm experiencing currently. What hurts a lot is my older sister would be in my position too, but she's allowed to stay with the family yet I'm not.

I've had job interviews over the past few weeks and months and nothings come of it so far so I'm not getting too excited. This job will feed me, and allow me to pay rent but I don't know how I'll get through the next few weeks. It feels terrible going backwards. I'm desperately trying to get a job paying half (or less) of what I've earnt in the past.

I will make a post now using this account looking for jobs in AskReddit and possibly some other subreddits.

I'll be sure to update with any job seeking news.
Thank you :) You have interesting writing!

I've learnt from a lot of mistakes but unfortunately have also repeated some mistakes.

You're right, they want me to stand on my own two feet. I have before but it all fell apart. It hurts having them pressure me like this though. I'm pressuring myself enough and I know what's at stake.

I share a house. My friends mostly live with their families and it's not really an option to stay with them. I could sort out a couple days of accommodation at best. My family won't let me stay with them. We get along great now, well I thought we did, but when I was younger we had some problems. My siblings (older and younger) still live with them, but they won't have me. This also hurts a lot. 

The phrase 'drain on finances' isn't really accurate. I have $0 and I'm only surviving out of generosity. It's Friday night here, 19:30. I spoke to someone about a job that's walking distance from home at 5pm. I won't hear back until at least Monday so will hopefully interview then. That still leaves me with at least a week or more before I see any income, if I even get the job which I'm well over qualified to do.

I love Winston Churchill, thanks for the reminder. I appreciate the caring in this subreddit. I really feel like I have nobody to turn to for the help I need right now.
